signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use your platform account.
signIn.failed: That username and password did not match an account.

pitch.title: One account for every cvhome app.
pitch.copy: Sign in once to reach the seller console and the services behind it.

signIn.expired: That page had expired. Please sign in again.
signIn.locked: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes, or ask an administrator.
signIn.disabled: This account has been disabled. Ask an administrator.
signIn.expiredPassword: Your password has expired. Ask an administrator for a reset link.
signIn.forgotCopy: There is no self-service reset on this platform. Ask an administrator: they can issue you a one-time link from the console, and it will bring you back here with a new password.

empty.title: No accounts
empty.message: uaa has no accounts registered yet.
empty.noMatchMessage: Nothing matches that search and status. Clear one or both.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.message: Choose a new password for {{name}}. They will not be asked to change it at next sign-in.
reset.hint: At least twelve characters, mixing letters, digits and symbols.
reset.handoverHint: You will not be able to read this again — hand it over before you close the dialog.
reset.weak: That password is too easy to guess.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

roles.empty: uaa offers no roles this account may be given.

delete.title: Delete this account
delete.message: {{name}} will be removed from uaa. There is no undo and no soft delete.

toast.resent: A new link was issued for {{name}}.
toast.resetLinkIssued: A reset link was issued for {{name}}.

detail.createHint: Creates the account and asks you for its password next. To let the person choose their own, invite them instead.
detail.usernameHint: What the account signs in with. It cannot be changed afterwards.
detail.enabledHint: A disabled account keeps its roles and cannot sign in.
detail.metadataHint: Removing a row unsets that key on save. `org` and `store` are written by tenancy and read by other services.
detail.usernameLocked: The username is the identity tokens carry; it cannot be changed.
detail.emailHint: Changing the address marks it unverified again.

filter.label: Filter accounts by status
filter.search: Search by name, username or email

empty.title: No invitations
empty.message: Nothing here with that status. Invite someone from the button above.

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.hint: The account is created without a password. You will get a one-time link for them to choose one.
invite.usernameHint: Optional — the email address when left blank.
invite.delivery: Nothing emails the link yet. You will be shown it once, to pass on yourself; it is valid for seven days.

resetLink.title: Issue a reset link
resetLink.message: A one-time link for {{name}} to choose a new password. Their current password keeps working until they do.
resetLink.revokeHint: Ends every session and token now. For a suspected compromise, not for a forgotten password.
resetLink.validity: The link is valid for one hour and is shown once.

issued.message: Send this to {{name}}. It works once and expires {{expires}}.
issued.warning: This is the only time the link is shown. Copy it before closing — only its hash is stored, and a resend issues a different one.

revoke.title: Revoke this invitation
revoke.message: The link sent to {{email}} will stop working. The pending account stays and can be re-invited.

roles.title: Roles
roles.context: Named sets of permissions, issued in tokens as the roles claim
roles.permsHint: {{direct}} granted directly; the number shown includes what is inherited

notice.rename: Renaming a role does not re-issue anyone's token: whoever is signed in keeps the old authority until they sign in again.

empty.title: No roles
empty.message: uaa has no roles registered yet.

form.name: Role name
form.nameHint: Appears verbatim in the token's roles claim. Upper-case letters, digits and underscores.
form.scopeHint: Realm: across every client. Organization: inside one seller organization. Client: only through one application.
form.inheritsHint: Everything the parent grants is granted here too.
form.catalogueUnavailable: The permission catalogue could not be loaded; name, scope and parent can still be saved.
form.description: What the role grants is issued in the token as the permissions claim; services still authorise on the role name.
form.systemNotice: A system role: its name and scope are fixed because services key on them. Its description, parent and permissions can still change.

delete.title: Delete this role
delete.message: {{name}} will be removed. uaa refuses if any account still holds it.
delete.confirmationLabel: Type the role name to confirm

clients.title: OAuth2 clients
clients.context: The applications that authenticate against uaa

notice.secret: uaa never returns a client secret. The only moment you can read one is the moment you set it — copy it before you close the dialog.

empty.title: No clients
empty.message: No applications are registered against uaa yet.

rotate.title: Set a new secret
rotate.message: Choose a new secret for {{clientId}}. The old one stops working immediately.
rotate.hint: At least twenty characters. Treat it like a password.
rotate.handoverHint: uaa will not show this again — copy it into the application's configuration now.
rotate.weak: That secret is too easy to guess.
rotate.mismatch: The two secrets do not match.

delete.title: Delete this client
delete.message: {{clientId}} will be removed, and any application using it can no longer obtain a token.
delete.confirmationLabel: Type the client id to confirm

toast.secretRotated: A new secret was set for {{clientId}}.

clientForm.context: What the application is allowed to ask uaa for
clientForm.invalid: Some settings still need attention — see the checklist.
clientForm.clientIdHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at least three characters. Changing it breaks every integration already using it.
clientForm.redirectEmpty: Required when authorization_code is one of the grant types.
clientForm.logoutEmpty: Optional. Where uaa may send the browser after a sign-out.
clientForm.requireProofKeyHint: Mandatory for a public client, which is one that holds no secret.
clientForm.requireConsentHint: The user approves the requested scopes the first time they sign in.
clientForm.jwkSetUrlHint: Where uaa fetches the client’s public keys. Needed for private_key_jwt.
clientForm.tokenEndpointAlgHint: How the client signs its assertion at the token endpoint.
clientForm.subjectDnHint: The certificate uaa expects for tls_client_auth.
clientForm.authorizationCodeTtlHint: How long a code stays redeemable. Short by design.
clientForm.deviceCodeTtlHint: How long a device-flow code stays valid.
clientForm.ttlHint: Leave the amount empty for uaa’s default.
clientForm.reuseRefreshTokensHint: Off rotates the refresh token on every use, which is the safer choice.
clientForm.certificateBoundHint: Binds a token to the client’s mTLS certificate.
clientForm.accessTokenFormatHint: Self-contained tokens are readable by any service holding the key; reference tokens are not.

check.clientId: Client id set, and in the accepted shape
check.redirectRequired: A redirect URI, which authorization_code needs
check.redirectOptional: No redirect URI needed for these grant types
check.pkceRequired: PKCE is on, which a public client requires
check.pkceOptional: PKCE optional for a client that holds a secret
check.jwkSetUrl: JWK Set URL, where private_key_jwt needs one
check.subjectDn: Subject DN, where tls_client_auth needs one

uri.invalid: Enter an absolute URI, including its scheme.
uri.insecure: Plain HTTP to a remote host — anything on the network path can read the code delivered here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.context: Realm-wide policy; changes apply to every client on save

email.notBuilt: Not built: the platform has no mail sender. Links are handed to an event a delivery service will subscribe to.

general.subtitle: How the realm presents itself
general.selfRegistrationHint: Not available: staff accounts are created by an administrator or by invitation.
general.requireVerificationHint: An unverified account cannot sign in.

authentication.subtitle: What a password must be, and what happens when it is guessed

password.title: Password policy
password.rejectBreachedHint: Checked against the Have I Been Pwned k-anonymity range API when a password is set.

lockout.title: Brute-force protection
lockout.permanentAfterHint: 0 = never; an administrator must then unlock.

sessions.subtitle: How long a sign-in lasts
sessions.notice: Clients inherit the token defaults unless they override them in their own token settings.
sessions.idleHint: Signs the user out after this period of inactivity.
sessions.rememberMeHint: Extends the session with a remember-me cookie.
sessions.singleHint: A new sign-in revokes older sessions.

tokens.title: Token defaults
tokens.maxAccessHint: No client may issue a longer access token.
tokens.secretGraceHint: The previous secret keeps working this long after a rotation.

keys.subtitle: When the signing key rotates and how long retired keys stay verifiable
keys.retireDays: Keep retiring keys in the JWKS for
keys.retireHint: In-flight tokens still verify during this window.

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: Prove it is you with the current one
password.notice: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else and ends every token issued to you.
password.hint: At least the realm's minimum length, with the character classes it requires.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Where you are signed in
sessions.noneHint: uaa lists nothing for this account.

subtitle.INVITATION: Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
subtitle.PASSWORD_RESET: Your old password stops working once you save the new one.

linkAccept.noToken: This page needs the link you were sent. Open it from there.

message.INVITATION: It has expired, was revoked, or was already used. Ask the administrator who invited you for a new one.
message.PASSWORD_RESET: It has expired, was revoked, or was already used. Ask an administrator for a new one.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.message: The link could not be checked right now. Try again in a moment.

done.message: Sign in as {{name}} with the password you just chose.
